title: Plugin Broker Transport Layer
description: Relay and lifecycle for plugin core IPC; not a translator of payloads.
body: The broker: one plugin's frontend asking a question its own core answers. A relay and not a translator: nothing here inspects a payload or enumerates a method, because the vocabulary belongs to the plugin, not to the protocol. Mostly lifecycle, therefore — when a core starts, when it stops, and what happens to a call that arrives while it is neither. `ToolProcess` is cached per package, so two surfaces of one plugin route to the same core.
